title: Route Instance
description: Structured routing result for a copywriting task. Output after task analysis, before generation.

platforms.description: Multiple platforms if task_type is multi_platform

purpose.description: Content purpose: content value / preference building / decision completion

ip_mode.description: Standard brand copy or IP-personality copy

target_words.description: Target word count (budget, not hard KPI)

product_fact_source.description: Source of product facts. official_web / authorized_official_listing / mixed_verified are set after Product Source Retrieval succeeds; must NOT remain 'unknown' after a successful search (PATCH 14).

product_identity_status.description: Certainty that the user's product name uniquely maps to the current SKU. A product name alone does NOT imply EXACT; multiple age versions / specs / generations / formulas / regional variants make it PARTIAL (PATCH 08).

product_fact_sufficiency.description: Adequacy of product facts for the current purpose. Separated from product_fact_source: user input may identify the product without being a sufficient Product Fact Source (PATCH 01).

product_retrieval_status.description: Status of product information retrieval. If WEB_SEARCH exists and sufficiency is below the purpose requirement, status must leave NOT_NEEDED and reach SEARCHING/RESOLVED/AMBIGUOUS/FAILED before any user data request (PATCH 14/22/23).

product_regulatory_category.description: Regulatory category of the current SKU. Must be identified before writing product copy; if unknown and WEB_SEARCH exists, retrieve official label / registration / filing identity instead of guessing from words like nutrition pack / wellness / beauty (PATCH 02).

claim_authority_level.description: Expression permission level of the strongest claim in this piece. L6 must never enter the body (PATCH 01).

claim_strength.description: Claim Strength = Maximum Strength Supported by Evidence. Strong authority means no unnecessary weakening; subjective only means no escalation (PATCH 07).

commercial_value_path.description: For Sell: the Problem → Benefit purchase-reason path (Authorized Function / Convenience / Product Difference / Routine Simplification / Verified Experience / Value / Cost). Absent = Commercial Usefulness FAIL (PATCH 08).

implication_level.description: Highest implication level used in this piece. I1-I3 open, I4 conditioned (needs Authorized Claim or sufficient evidence), I5-A hard prohibited (disease/treatment/prevention/clear physiological result, any intensity level), I5-B high-risk but contextual (state fatigue/skin anxiety/age anxiety as audience context landing on product friction), I5-C acceptable strong implication (non-sensitive categories, main semantic still in legal value domain) (PATCH v4.11.0).

pain_distance.description: Distance between product facts and the pain addressed. DIRECT_PAIN: direct solution. PARTIAL_PAIN: addresses a key friction; boundary is enforced internally and need not appear as disclaimer copy. CONTEXT_PAIN: audience context; for non-sensitive claims it may be the main selling point when semantic back-translation stays within the claim ceiling.

commercial_intensity.description: Commercial intensity level, selected by category + platform + user goal. Controls how strongly to express (I5-B/C space, pain distance, AMBER zone) without changing Claim Ceiling. CONSERVATIVE: current strict standard. STANDARD (default): moderate relaxation. AGGRESSIVE: non-sensitive categories allow stronger scene impact and identity implication; hard efficacy smuggling still prohibited (PATCH v4.11.0).

humanization_pipeline.description: Humanization composition route. External skills provide advisory findings or candidate revisions only; master-copywriting retains final authority over truth, claim ceiling, platform purpose, commercial value and CTA permission.

humanization_passes.description: Publish-ready copy runs two humanization passes: H1 after drafting, H2 after the full G1-G12 review and repair.

final_invariant_check.description: Read-only verification after H2 for Meaning Lock, facts, numbers, claims, identity, purpose, CTA permission and core buying reason. FAIL returns to full review; the check itself must not rewrite.

voice_source_status.description: Evidence available for matching a specific personal voice. Specific voice claims are allowed only with USER_SAMPLES or APPROVED_PROFILE.

pain_translation_path.description: For Sell/Seed: the Pain Translation chain (P1 Surface Complaint → P2 Daily Friction → P3 Emotional Cost → P4 Desired Progress → P5 Product Bridge) passed through the Product-to-Pain Match Gate. Absent = Commercial Translation FAIL (PATCH 15).

benefit_translation_domain.description: Legal benefit domain(s) used when health efficacy is unavailable: Convenience / Routine Simplicity / Decision Reduction / Portability / Time Saving / Consistency Support / Sensory Experience / Format Innovation / Cost Value / Authorized Function / Verified Performance / Lifestyle Fit / Risk Reduction / Choice Confidence (PATCH 06).

expression_freedom_level.description: Expression Layer freedom level. EXPRESSION_OPEN (default): metaphor/analogy/homophony/pun/contrast/plot/scene演绎/dialogue/吐槽/internet language/emotional amplification/colloquial exaggeration/user原话/dramatic conflict/life scenes all open, but expression form must not create a new Product Claim. EXPRESSION_RESTRICTED only when a specific platform/law requires it (PATCH v4.9.0).

rhetorical_exaggeration.description: Whether rhetorical exaggeration is allowed. ALLOWED for emotional/lifestyle/rhetorical exaggeration (e.g. '看着都累'); PROHIBITED for factual inflation (real value → bigger number, possible → certain, some users → everyone, Authorized Claim → stronger body result). Emotional exaggeration is allowed. Factual exaggeration is not (PATCH v4.9.0).

back_translation_result.description: Result of Semantic Back-Translation for metaphor/homophony/plot/implication/pun/keyword substitution: translate the expression into plain language and judge whether the effect an ordinary consumer understands remains within the Claim Ceiling. PASS = has Claim Authority or is only legal life/emotional value; FAIL = adds a health/medical/physiological efficacy (PATCH v4.9.0).

anxiety_type.description: Anxiety type dynamically selected for this piece. Product Truth chooses the anxiety, not the reverse. Each anxiety must pass the Anxiety Legitimacy Gate (Source / Reality / Product Relevance) (PATCH v4.10.0).

pain_specificity_score.description: 0 = abstract concept (e.g. '现代人很忙'); 1 = concrete pain but weak scene; 2 = user immediately recognizes the specific scene and friction. Sell default: Pain Specificity must not be 0 (PATCH v4.10.0).

scene_vividness_score.description: 0 = no picture; 1 = has scene words; 2 = has at least two of action/object/time/conflict. Douyin targets 2; Xiaohongshu at least a verifiable/referenceable real scene; Channels credible and retellable; OA may reduce shot detail but needs a real problem structure (PATCH v4.10.0).

anxiety_legitimacy.description: Each anxiety passes Source Test (real source, not AI-invented) + Reality Test (problem exists without advertising) + Product Relevance Test (product can really reduce it). Any failure = switch anxiety (PATCH v4.10.0).

relief_path.description: Sell/Seed must give an exit after anxiety (Anxiety → Relief Path); Content may only raise awareness. Never press anxiety without a resolution logic (PATCH v4.10.0).

core_proposition.description: Core proposition for this piece (1 sentence)

preference_target.description: For Seed: what preference is being built

primary_proof_type.description: Primary proof type for this platform/task

ip_asset_target.description: IP asset to build in this piece

product_role.description: Role of product in this content

content_format.description: Content format of this route instance

audience_temperature.description: Audience temperature. Affects information depth, objection handling, offer explanation only; never affects CTA permission.

first_goal.description: Unique first goal of this piece (e.g., purchase_decision). Business goal is separate from language action permission.

commercial_relationship.description: Commercial relationship between creator and product. Belongs to the route instance, not the product.

cta_permission.description: CTA language permission. IMPLICIT_ONLY by default; EXPLICIT_ALLOWED only via the Closed Explicit CTA Allowlist.

closing_strategy.description: Closing strategy. NATURAL_STOP preferred; EXPLICIT_CTA only when cta_permission = EXPLICIT_ALLOWED.

references_to_load.description: References to load for this task (progressive disclosure)

verification_limits.description: What cannot be auto-verified in this runtime. Describes verification limits only; never lowers Product/Identity/Numeric/External/Demonstration truth standards.
